abstract: Evaluates commercial export pricing spreads, destination port premiums, and forward hedging commitments
system_message:
You are the Agricultural trade marketing economist (MKT). Your role is to evaluate commercial export pricing spreads, destination port premiums, forward hedging commitments, and cash basis monitoring across prospective grain export corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cash basis monitoring（BASIS）
information_points.content:
MKT-BASIS-2T7：For the Ohio Basin Direct Rail-Barge Corridor, the local cash price basis premium is reported at 24 USD/t relative to nearby exchange contract pricing for spot elevator delivery.
MKT-BASIS-SPW：For the Illinois Inland Waterway Unit-Train Corridor, the local cash price basis premium stands at 36 USD/t over nearby futures settlement for spot delivery elevator transactions.
MKT-BASIS-IHL：For the Upper Mississippi Riverway Multimodal Corridor, the local cash price basis premium is 12 USD/t over the futures settlement price for spot delivery elevator intake.

information_points.title: Evaluates commercial export pricing spreads, destination port premiums, and forward hedging commitments（EXPORT）
information_points.content:
MKT-EXPORT-NVP：For the Illinois Inland Waterway Unit-Train Corridor, seasonal forward contract export coverage is recorded at 84% based on committed autumn shipment sales contracts booked with overseas buyers.
MKT-EXPORT-YGR：For the Upper Mississippi Riverway Multimodal Corridor, seasonal forward contract export coverage is documented at 42% based on firm autumn shipment contracts booked with overseas buyers.
MKT-EXPORT-RY6：For the Ohio Basin Direct Rail-Barge Corridor, seasonal forward contract export coverage stands at 42% according to firm autumn shipment contracts booked with overseas buyers.
